text: ふむ……　レッド　と　いうんだな！

structure.jp: レッド　と　いうんだな！

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.span: レッド　と　いう
patterns.explanation: A name followed by と いう says what someone is called. レッド と いう = 'you are called Red'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ after a verb, short for のだ, gives the feeling of 'so that's how it is', as if he has just understood something. いうんだ = 'so you're called that'.

patterns.name: 〜な
patterns.explanation: な at the end shows the speaker confirming something to himself, like 'I see' or 'right'. レッド と いうんだな = 'so you're called Red, I see'.
